subject: Tenant asset excision confirmation and acceptance notices
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@novamed.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-02T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Request: full excision of tenant artifacts for Project Helix

Hi Aditya,

Per our data residency obligations and the termination of our pilot, legal has asked us to request a complete excision of any tenant-level artifacts related to Novamed Project Helix (prompt inputs, model outputs, KV caches, and inference logs) from any Redwood-hosted storage and logs.

High-level ask:
- Delete prompt input traces and derivative artifacts for tenant ID novamed-prod-helix
- Purge KV cache snapshots and any ephemeral traces stored in fast-cache layers
- Remove inference logs older than 30 days and provide a manifest of items deleted
- Provide a signed acceptance notice we can retain for audit

Can you confirm Redwood's workflow and expected timeline? Legal is aiming to close the compliance checklist by 2026-12-10.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of IT Compliance
Novamed

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, elena.rossi@novamed.com
Date: 2026-12-02T10:01:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: full excision of tenant artifacts for Project Helix

Marissa / Neha — forwarding Novamed's excision request. They asked for confirmation + signed acceptance by 12/10. Can you confirm the ops steps, owners, and ETA for the manifest + proof package?

Proposed scope (please adjust):
- Step 1: Identify all buckets / tables / KV namespaces containing tenant novamed-prod-helix (Marissa)
- Step 2: Execute deletion in hosted environment and Dedicated caches; record object keys and ledger ids (Neha)
- Step 3: Generate CSV manifest and SHA256 hashes, upload to secure S3 evidence path (Ben)
- Step 4: Provide signed confirmation PDF we can pass to customer; scope includes logs, prompt outputs, model derivatives

Please reply with owners & ETA. Elena — looping you in so you can see the plan.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: elena.rossi@novamed.com
Date: 2026-12-03T11:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: full excision of tenant artifacts for Project Helix

Aditya — confirmed. Owners and timeline below:

- Marissa Cole (Ops lead): inventory of tenant artifacts and cross-check with retention index — complete by 2026-12-05 EOD.
- Neha Kapoor (Engineering): run deletion jobs across storage planes (object store, KV cache snapshots, and eviction of active caches). Deletions scheduled for 2026-12-06 02:00–04:00 UTC (low traffic window).
- Ben Carter (Security / Evidence): generate manifest, compute SHA256, upload to restricted S3, and produce acceptance package — ready by 2026-12-07 17:00 PST.

Attachments: redwood-erasure-playbook-v3.pdf (playbook excerpt) — referenced steps and safeguards.

Notes:
- We will not delete model weights or shared system models; only tenant-scoped artifacts and logs.
- We will keep an internal audit trace (immutable ledger entry id) that records the deletion action for our operational compliance; Novamed will receive the manifest and evidence package only.
- If legal needs DocuSign, Ben will prepare the signed acceptance PDF after Novamed confirms the manifest.

Elena — does that timeline work for your audit?

-marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Operations Manager, Redwood Inference

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, elena.rossi@novamed.com
Date: 2026-12-06T05:46:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Deletion job scheduled + pre-checks completed

All — quick update from engineering after pre-checks:

- Inventory: confirmed 4 object buckets, 2 KV namespaces, and 1 ephemeral cache shard containing novamed-prod-helix artifacts. (Inventory excerpt attached in manifest CSV.)
- Pre-deletion snapshot: we preserved a short-lived snapshot in an encrypted staging area for 48 hours for rollback if Novamed raises a concern. Snapshot will be auto-expired 2026-12-08T05:00:00 UTC.
- Deletion run: completed as scheduled 2026-12-06T02:18–02:53 UTC. Jobs returned success codes and ledger ids.

We have the deletion ledger ids and object keys. Ben is producing the CSV manifest with hashes and a redwood-issued acceptance stub.

-Neha
Neha Kapoor
Principal Software Engineer, Platform Reliability

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: elena.rossi@novamed.com, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-08T17:42:00-08:00
Subject: Final: erasure manifest and signed acceptance for Novamed Project Helix

Elena — attaching the evidence package for your records.

Summary:
- Deletion window: 2026-12-06T02:18–02:53 UTC
- Items deleted: prompt-inputs (7,321 objects), model-derivative artifacts (1,142 objects), KV snapshots (2 namespaces — 6 snapshot files), inference logs (older than 30d — 18 log files).
- Manifest: redwood-erasure-manifest-20261207.csv (SHA256: 3f7b...a1c2) uploaded to s3://redwood-evidence/novamed/.
- Evidence: novamed-ack-docusign-20261208.pdf — DocuSign-ready acceptance statement (prepared for Elena / Novamed Legal).

Attached files: redwood-erasure-manifest-20261207.csv (CSV of keys + ledger ids + hashes), novamed-ack-docusign-20261208.pdf (PDF acceptance template).

Signed acceptance flow: please review the manifest and, if everything aligns with your expectations, sign the PDF and return. Once we receive it we will mark the deletion action as "customer-accepted" in our compliance ledger and close the ticket.

If you need any additional evidence (screenshots of deletion job logs, expanded hash details, or per-object copies), reply and we'll include them in a sealed bundle.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Lead, Security Engineering
Redwood Inference
